t: Donsu | the-Noh.com | Noh Terminology
s: A kind of textile. Under the name kinran-donsu, it is a byword for high-grade textiles. Donsu has woven patterns with different weaves on a base of glossy satin. A variety of colour threads are sometimes used to create beautiful and complex patterns. Donsu was imported from China in medieval times and valued highly; later, in the Tenshō era (1573-1592), it came to be produced in the Nishijin area of Kyoto.
